prompts.title: Présentation personnelle
prompts.situation: You are meeting a French-speaking person for the first time.
points: your name and where you are from
prompts.prompt:
Situation: You are meeting a French-speaking person for the first time.

Task: Introduce yourself in French. Include your name, origin, city, occupation, languages, and hobbies.

Speak for approximately 1-2 minutes.

prompts.title: Décrire votre famille
prompts.situation: You are showing a French friend photos of your family and friends.
prompts.task: Describe the people in the photograph.
prompts.prompt:
Situation: You are showing a French friend photos of your family.

Task: Describe the people, their relationship to you, their traits, and what you do together.

Speak for approximately 1-2 minutes.

prompts.title: Le week-end dernier
prompts.situation: A French colleague asks you about your weekend activities.
prompts.task: Tell what you did last weekend.
points: where you went and with whom
two or three activities you completed
how you felt about the weekend
prompts.prompt:
Situation: A colleague asks about your weekend.

Task: Recount your weekend in the past tense (passé composé). Describe where you went, what you did, and how it was.

Speak for approximately 1-2 minutes.

prompts.title: L'équilibre vie professionnelle et personnelle
prompts.situation: You participate in an online French conversation club on lifestyle.
prompts.task: Express your thoughts on telecommuting and work-life balance.
prompts.prompt:
Task: Discuss remote work and work-life balance. Share advantages, disadvantages, and your personal experience.

Speak for approximately 2 minutes.
